# Coming Attractions

<!-- Generated by npm run records -- build. Edit production.json and canonical documents. -->

Status: **published**.

First draft 2026-10-26, then nine review cuts to 2026-10-30 on the director's notes: a feel-cut, a photoreal exterior intro reshot from behind her, the year 2027, an iris out and in, the ending remade as her alone walking out and a humanoid robot walking in, a short S06, and the Coming Attractions banner remade as a card projected on a 1940s screen. v9 was approved by the director on 2026-10-30 ("It's perfect.") and published the same day as a YouTube Short (URL user-confirmed). The 4K finishing master v9-4k is the published master; the native v9 is its source. The revision history is on the status page; the workspace is archived under the standard retention.
